cmi.mod.name: Character Mod Isolation
cmi.page.title: Character Mod Isolation
cmi.page.desc: Hide content added by character mods when the current run has only vanilla characters. Character mods stay enabled and selectable.
cmi.general.desc: Changes apply to the next run. The current run keeps its decision.
cmi.master.name: Enable isolation
cmi.master.desc: Off makes this mod do nothing.
cmi.source.name: Detection mode
cmi.source.desc: Automatic detects character mods. Manual skips detection and isolates only the mods you check.
cmi.verbose.name: Verbose log
cmi.verbose.desc: Logs every filter decision. Keep off unless diagnosing.
cmi.mods.desc: Automatic mode uses role evidence. Manual mode isolates exactly the checked mods.
cmi.mods.empty.desc: Content from built-in game assemblies is never isolated.
cmi.rescan.name: Re-detect character mods
cmi.auto.manual: Manual mode: automatic detection is not running.
